evidence: The atmosphere is always convivial, with low plastic stools nestled close to the edge of the sidewalk, bustling with traffic flowing back and forth under the shade of trees. The dish itself is a symphony of textures and colors, with pristine white Bun Roi intertwined with the golden-brown, glistening color of Chiên Dau.
